metaTitle: Custom Rectangular Gift Boxes & Ribbons | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom rectangular gift boxes and ribbons in bulk. Perfect for corporate gifting. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Rectangular gift boxes offer a classic, stackable shape that simplifies packaging and shipping for bulk corporate orders. Unlike square or specialty shapes, rectangular boxes fit standard ribbon widths neatly and allow for efficient use of shelf or storage space. Whether you're pairing a 9x6x4 corrugated box with a matching satin ribbon for a polished employee gift set or using dye-sublimated ribbons to reinforce brand colors, this shape provides a versatile canvas for screen printing, foil stamping, or full-color decoration.
heroAltText: Stack of custom rectangular gift boxes with branded ribbon, ready for corporate gifting
